65	    def _handle(self) -> None:
66	        try:
67	            status, response = self._dispatch()
68	            self._json(status, response)
69	        except SwarmGridError as error:
70	            self._json(error.status, {"error": {"code": error.code, "message": str(error)}})
71	        except Exception:
72	            self._json(500, {"error": {"code": "internal_error", "message": "internal server error"}})
73	
74	    do_GET = _handle
75	    do_POST = _handle

80	    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")

70	            raise ValidationError("mission must be an object")
71	        unknown = sorted(set(raw) - {"id", "map_id", "agents"})
72	        if unknown:
73	            raise ValidationError(f"mission contains unknown fields: {', '.join(unknown)}")
74	        for field in ("id", "map_id", "agents"):
75	            if field not in raw:
76	                raise ValidationError(f"mission is missing required field: {field}")
77	        mission_id = identifier(raw["id"], "mission id")
78	        map_id = identifier(raw["map_id"], "map_id")

88	            state = {

93	                "agents": [agent.as_dict() for agent in mission.agents],
94	            }

111	            "SELECT state, plan FROM missions WHERE id = ?", (mission_id,)

120	        """Plan `mission_id`, returning the stored plan when it was already solved."""
121	
122	        def resolve() -> dict[str, Any]:
123	            state, stored_plan = self._load_mission(mission_id)
124	            if state["status"] == "solved" and stored_plan is not None:
125	                return stored_plan

136	                state["planned_at"] = self.store.now()
137	                self.store.connection.execute(
138	                    "UPDATE missions SET state = ?, plan = ? WHERE id = ?",
139	                    (self.store.encode(state), self.store.encode(plan), mission_id),

143	                state["planned_at"] = self.store.now()

145	                    "UPDATE missions SET state = ?, plan = NULL WHERE id = ?",

152	    def schedule(self, mission_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
153	        """Timeline of the solved plan: one frame per timestep from 0 to makespan."""
154	        state, plan = self._load_mission(mission_id)
155	        if state["status"] != "solved" or plan is None:
156	            raise ConflictError(f"mission {mission_id} has no solved plan to schedule")
157	        paths = {
158	            entry["agent_id"]: [(int(cell[0]), int(cell[1])) for cell in entry["path"]]
159	            for entry in plan["agents"]
160	        }
161	        return {
162	            "mission_id": mission_id,
163	            "map_id": state["map_id"],
164	            "makespan": plan["makespan"],

172	                        )
173	                        for agent_id, path in sorted(paths.items())
174	                    },
175	                }

184	    def _plan_options(self, raw: Any, mission: Mission) -> tuple[list[str] | None, int, int]:
185	        if raw is None:
186	            return None, DEFAULT_ORDER_BUDGET, DEFAULT_TREE_BUDGET
187	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
188	            raise ValidationError("plan body must be an object")
189	        unknown = sorted(set(raw) - {"priority", "order_budget", "tree_budget"})
190	        if unknown:
191	            raise ValidationError(f"plan body contains unknown fields: {', '.join(unknown)}")
192	        known = sorted(agent.id for agent in mission.agents)
193	        priority = raw.get("priority")
194	        if priority is not None:
195	            if not isinstance(priority, list) or any(
196	                not isinstance(agent_id, str) or not agent_id for agent_id in priority
197	            ):
198	                raise ValidationError("priority must be an array of non-empty agent id strings")
199	            if len(set(priority)) != len(priority):
200	                raise ValidationError("priority must not repeat an agent id")
201	            if sorted(priority) != known:
202	                raise ValidationError("priority must list every agent of the mission exactly once")
203	        budget = raw.get("order_budget", DEFAULT_ORDER_BUDGET)
204	        if isinstance(budget, bool) or not isinstance(budget, int) or budget < 1 or budget > MAX_ORDER_BUDGET:
205	            raise ValidationError(f"order_budget must be an integer between 1 and {MAX_ORDER_BUDGET}")
206	        tree_budget = raw.get("tree_budget", DEFAULT_TREE_BUDGET)
207	        if (

210	            or tree_budget < 0

212	        ):
213	            raise ValidationError(f"tree_budget must be an integer between 0 and {MAX_TREE_BUDGET}")
214	        return (list(priority) if priority is not None else None), budget, tree_budget

217	        raw = {
218	            "id": state["id"],
219	            "map_id": state["map_id"],
220	            "agents": [
221	                {"id": entry["id"], "start": entry["start"], "goal": entry["goal"]}
222	                for entry in state["agents"]

227	    def _materialize(self, mission: Mission, result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
228	        by_id = {agent.id: agent for agent in mission.agents}
229	        if result.status == "solved":
230	            agents = [
231	                {
232	                    "agent_id": agent_id,
233	                    "start": list(by_id[agent_id].start),
234	                    "goal": list(by_id[agent_id].goal),
235	                    "arrival": len(path) - 1,
236	                    "path": [list(cell) for cell in path],
237	                }
238	                for agent_id, path in zip(result.order, result.paths)
239	            ]
240	            return {
241	                "mission_id": mission.id,
242	                "map_id": mission.map_id,
243	                "status": "solved",
244	                "method": result.method,
245	                "makespan": result.solution_makespan,
246	                "priority_order": list(result.order),
247	                "orders_tried": result.orders_tried,
248	                "orders_budget": result.orders_budget,
249	                "agents": sorted(agents, key=lambda entry: entry["agent_id"]),
250	            }
251	        return {
252	            "mission_id": mission.id,
253	            "map_id": mission.map_id,
254	            "status": "unsolvable",
255	            "method": None,
256	            "makespan": None,
257	            "priority_order": [],
258	            "orders_tried": result.orders_tried,
259	            "orders_budget": result.orders_budget,
260	            "conflicts": [conflict.as_dict() for conflict in result.conflicts],

263	    def _assert_plan_invariants(self, mission: Mission, plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
264	        """Fail loudly rather than publish a plan that breaks the documented invariants."""
265	        if plan["status"] != "solved":
266	            return
267	        map_record = self._load_map(mission.map_id)
268	        by_id = {agent.id: agent for agent in mission.agents}
269	        order: list[Agent] = []
270	        paths: list[tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]] = []
271	        for entry in plan["agents"]:
272	            agent_id = entry["agent_id"]
273	            path = tuple(tuple(cell) for cell in entry["path"])
274	            if not path or path[0] != by_id[agent_id].start or path[-1] != by_id[agent_id].goal:
275	                raise ConflictError("internal planner error: a path does not join start to goal")
276	            for index, cell in enumerate(path):
277	                if not map_record.walkable(cell):
278	                    raise ConflictError("internal planner error: a path crosses an obstacle")
279	                if index and abs(path[index - 1][0] - cell[0]) + abs(path[index - 1][1] - cell[1]) > 1:
280	                    raise ConflictError("internal planner error: a path is not continuous")
281	            if entry["arrival"] != len(path) - 1:
282	                raise ConflictError("internal planner error: arrival does not match the path length")
283	            order.append(by_id[agent_id])
284	            paths.append(path)
285	        if len({tuple(path[-1]) for path in paths}) != len(paths):
286	            raise ConflictError("internal planner error: two agents settle on the same goal cell")
287	        for timestep in range(plan["makespan"] + 1):
288	            held = [position_at(path, timestep) for path in paths]
289	            occupied = [cell for cell in held if cell is not None]
290	            if len(set(occupied)) != len(occupied):
291	                raise ConflictError("internal planner error: two agents share a cell at one timestep")
292	        if max(len(path) - 1 for path in paths) != plan["makespan"]:
293	            raise ConflictError("internal planner error: makespan is not the latest arrival")
294	        if detect_conflicts(tuple(order), paths):
295	            raise ConflictError("internal planner error: the published plan still has a conflict")

297	    def _idempotent(
298	        self, key: str | None, operation: str, action: Callable[[], dict[str, Any]]
299	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
300	        if not key:
301	            raise ValidationError("Idempotency-Key header is required")
302	        with self.store.transaction() as connection:
303	            existing = connection.execute(
304	                "SELECT operation, response FROM idempotency WHERE key = ?", (key,)
305	            ).fetchone()
306	            if existing:
307	                if existing["operation"] != operation:
308	                    raise ConflictError("idempotency key was already used for another operation")
309	                return self.store.decode(existing["response"])
310	            response = action()
311	            # Store and return the same encoding so a replayed request is
312	            # byte-identical to the first response.
313	            encoded = self.store.encode(response)
314	            connection.execute(
315	                "INSERT INTO idempotency(key, operation, response) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
316	                (key, operation, encoded),
317	            )
318	            return self.store.decode(encoded)

import unittest

from swarmgrid.model import Map, Mission
from swarmgrid.solver import (
    detect_conflicts,
    distance_map,
    makespan,
    position_at,
    space_time_astar,
)

OPEN_2X2 = {"id": "square", "width": 2, "height": 2, "grid": ["..", ".."]}


def build(map_payload, agents, mission_id="m"):
    map_record = Map.parse(map_payload)
    mission = Mission.parse({"id": mission_id, "map_id": map_payload["id"], "agents": agents}, map_record)
    return map_record, mission


class SingleAgentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_shortest_path_avoids_obstacles(self):
        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "w", "width": 5, "height": 2, "grid": ["..#..", "....."]},
            [{"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [4, 0]}],
        )
        agent = mission.agents[0]
        path, conflict = space_time_astar(map_record, agent, [], distance_map(map_record, agent.goal))
        self.assertIsNone(conflict)
        self.assertEqual((0, 0), path[0])
        self.assertEqual((4, 0), path[-1])
        self.assertEqual(6, makespan([path]))
        self.assertNotIn((2, 0), path)

    def test_waiting_is_used_when_a_cell_is_blocked_for_one_tick(self):
        map_record, mission = build(
            OPEN_2X2,
            [{"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [1, 0]}],
        )
        agent = mission.agents[0]
        blocked = frozenset({((1, 0), 1)})
        path, conflict = space_time_astar(
            map_record, agent, [], distance_map(map_record, agent.goal), blocked
        )
        self.assertIsNone(conflict)
        self.assertEqual(((0, 0), (0, 0), (1, 0)), path)

    def test_unreachable_goal_reports_a_conflict(self):
        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "w", "width": 5, "height": 3, "grid": [".#...", "##...", "....."]},
            [{"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [0, 2]}],
        )
        agent = mission.agents[0]
        path, conflict = space_time_astar(map_record, agent, [], distance_map(map_record, agent.goal))
        self.assertIsNone(path)
        self.assertEqual("unreachable_goal", conflict.type)


class OccupancyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_finished_agent_no_longer_occupies_its_goal(self):
        path = ((0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 0))
        self.assertEqual((1, 0), position_at(path, 1))
        self.assertIsNone(position_at(path, 3))

    def test_following_is_legal(self):
        lead = ((0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0))
        trail = ((1, 0), (1, 0), (1, 0), (1, 0))
        agents = (
            _agent("lead", (0, 0), (2, 0)),
            _agent("trail", (1, 0), (1, 0)),
        )
        # trail occupies (1, 0) from t=0; lead passes through it at t=1.
        # Sharing a cell is never allowed, so this plan must be reported.
        conflicts = detect_conflicts(agents, [lead, trail])
        self.assertTrue(any(conflict.type == "vertex" for conflict in conflicts))

        # When trail leaves on the same tick lead arrives, the two never share
        # the cell and the plan is clean.
        moving = ((1, 0), (1, 1), (1, 2), (2, 2))
        self.assertEqual([], detect_conflicts(agents, [lead, moving]))

    def test_a_swap_is_reported(self):
        first = ((0, 0), (1, 0))
        second = ((1, 0), (0, 0))
        agents = (_agent("a", (0, 0), (1, 0)), _agent("b", (1, 0), (0, 0)))
        conflicts = detect_conflicts(agents, [first, second])
        self.assertEqual(["edge"], [conflict.type for conflict in conflicts])
        self.assertEqual(0, conflicts[0].timestep)

    def test_sharing_a_cell_is_reported(self):
        first = ((0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 0))
        second = ((1, 0), (1, 0), (0, 0))
        agents = (_agent("a", (0, 0), (1, 0)), _agent("b", (1, 0), (0, 0)))
        conflicts = detect_conflicts(agents, [first, second])
        self.assertTrue(any(conflict.type == "vertex" for conflict in conflicts))

    def test_two_agents_settling_on_one_cell_is_a_conflict(self):
        first = ((0, 0), (1, 0))
        second = ((1, 1), (1, 0))
        agents = (_agent("a", (0, 0), (1, 0)), _agent("b", (1, 1), (1, 0)))
        conflicts = detect_conflicts(agents, [first, second])
        self.assertTrue(any(conflict.type == "vertex" for conflict in conflicts))


class JointPlanningTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_opposite_agents_in_a_corridor_are_routed_around_each_other(self):
        from swarmgrid.solver import plan_mission

        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "c", "width": 5, "height": 3, "grid": [".....", "..##.", "....."]},
            [
                {"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [4, 0]},
                {"id": "b", "start": [4, 0], "goal": [0, 0]},
            ],
        )
        result = plan_mission(map_record, mission)
        self.assertEqual("solved", result.status)
        self.assertEqual([], list(result.conflicts))
        self.assertEqual(8, result.solution_makespan)
        self.assertEqual([], detect_conflicts(
            tuple(sorted(mission.agents, key=lambda agent: agent.id)), list(result.paths)
        ))

    def test_the_constraint_tree_solves_what_a_single_order_cannot(self):
        from swarmgrid.solver import _constraint_tree, plan_mission

        map_record, mission = build(
            OPEN_2X2,
            [
                {"id": "a0", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [1, 1]},
                {"id": "a1", "start": [1, 0], "goal": [0, 0]},
            ],
        )
        agents = tuple(sorted(mission.agents, key=lambda agent: agent.id))
        distances = {agent.goal: distance_map(map_record, agent.goal) for agent in agents}
        paths, conflicts = _constraint_tree(map_record, agents, distances, 64)
        self.assertEqual([], conflicts)
        self.assertEqual([], detect_conflicts(agents, paths))
        self.assertEqual(3, makespan(paths))
        self.assertEqual(((0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 1)), tuple(paths[0]))
        self.assertEqual(((1, 0), (1, 1), (0, 1), (0, 0)), tuple(paths[1]))

        priority = plan_mission(map_record, mission)
        self.assertEqual("solved", priority.status)
        self.assertEqual("priority", priority.method)
        self.assertEqual(tuple(paths), priority.paths)

    def test_the_constraint_tree_stops_at_its_node_budget(self):
        from swarmgrid.solver import _constraint_tree

        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "lane", "width": 4, "height": 1, "grid": ["...."]},
            [
                {"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [3, 0]},
                {"id": "b", "start": [3, 0], "goal": [0, 0]},
            ],
        )
        agents = tuple(sorted(mission.agents, key=lambda agent: agent.id))
        distances = {agent.goal: distance_map(map_record, agent.goal) for agent in agents}
        paths, conflicts = _constraint_tree(map_record, agents, distances, 0)
        self.assertTrue(conflicts)
        self.assertEqual([], list(paths))

    def test_swapping_agents_in_a_single_lane_stay_unsolvable(self):
        from swarmgrid.solver import plan_mission

        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "lane", "width": 4, "height": 1, "grid": ["...."]},
            [
                {"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [3, 0]},
                {"id": "b", "start": [3, 0], "goal": [0, 0]},
            ],
        )
        result = plan_mission(map_record, mission, tree_budget=256)
        self.assertEqual("unsolvable", result.status)
        self.assertTrue(result.conflicts)
        self.assertEqual([], list(result.paths))

    def test_a_free_map_needs_no_replanning(self):
        from swarmgrid.solver import plan_mission

        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "open", "width": 6, "height": 4, "grid": ["......"] * 4},
            [
                {"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [5, 0]},
                {"id": "b", "start": [5, 3], "goal": [0, 3]},
            ],
        )
        result = plan_mission(map_record, mission)
        self.assertEqual("solved", result.status)
        self.assertEqual("priority", result.method)
        self.assertEqual(5, result.solution_makespan)


def _agent(agent_id, start, goal):
    from swarmgrid.model import Agent

    return Agent(agent_id, start, goal)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import json
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

from swarmgrid.server import Handler
from swarmgrid.service import SwarmGrid

MAP = {"id": "grid", "width": 5, "height": 3, "grid": [".....", "..##.", "....."]}
MISSION = {
    "id": "run-1",
    "map_id": "grid",
    "agents": [
        {"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [4, 0]},
        {"id": "b", "start": [4, 0], "goal": [0, 0]},
    ],
}


class ServerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        Handler.service = SwarmGrid(str(Path(self.directory.name) / "http.db"))
        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}"

    def tearDown(self):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join(timeout=5)
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def call(self, method, path, payload=None, key=None):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
        request = Request(f"{self.base}{path}", data=body, method=method)
        request.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        if key:
            request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", key)
        try:
            with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
                return response.status, json.loads(response.read())
        except HTTPError as error:
            try:
                return error.code, json.loads(error.read())
            finally:
                error.close()

    def raw(self, method, path, payload=None, key=None):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
        request = Request(f"{self.base}{path}", data=body, method=method)
        request.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        if key:
            request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", key)
        with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
            return response.status, response.read()

    def test_health(self):
        self.assertEqual((200, {"status": "ok"}), self.call("GET", "/health"))

    def test_full_planning_flow_over_http(self):
        status, created = self.call("POST", "/maps", MAP, "map-1")
        self.assertEqual(201, status)
        self.assertEqual("grid", created["id"])
        status, mission = self.call("POST", "/missions", MISSION, "mission-1")
        self.assertEqual(201, status)
        self.assertEqual("created", mission["status"])
        status, plan = self.call("POST", "/missions/run-1/plan", {}, "plan-1")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertEqual("solved", plan["status"])
        self.assertEqual(8, plan["makespan"])
        status, stored = self.call("GET", "/missions/run-1")
        self.assertEqual(plan, stored["plan"])
        status, schedule = self.call("GET", "/missions/run-1/schedule")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertEqual(9, len(schedule["timeline"]))
        self.assertEqual(
            {"a": None, "b": [0, 0]}, schedule["timeline"][-1]["positions"]
        )
        self.assertEqual("priority", plan["method"])

    def test_error_envelope_and_status_codes(self):
        status, error = self.call("POST", "/maps", {**MAP, "extra": 1}, "k1")
        self.assertEqual(400, status)
        self.assertEqual("validation_error", error["error"]["code"])
        status, error = self.call("GET", "/maps/missing")
        self.assertEqual(404, status)
        self.assertEqual("not_found", error["error"]["code"])
        status, error = self.call("POST", "/missions", MISSION, "k2")
        self.assertEqual(404, status)
        status, error = self.call("GET", "/nope")
        self.assertEqual(404, status)
        self.assertEqual("not_found", error["error"]["code"])

    def test_replayed_request_is_byte_identical(self):
        first_status, first = self.raw("POST", "/maps", MAP, "map-1")
        second_status, second = self.raw("POST", "/maps", MAP, "map-1")
        self.assertEqual(201, first_status)
        self.assertEqual(201, second_status)
        self.assertEqual(first, second)

    def test_idempotency_and_content_type(self):
        self.call("POST", "/maps", MAP, "map-1")
        status, first = self.call("POST", "/missions", MISSION, "same-key")
        self.assertEqual(201, status)
        status, repeated = self.call("POST", "/missions", MISSION, "same-key")
        self.assertEqual(201, status)
        self.assertEqual(first, repeated)
        request = Request(f"{self.base}/maps", data=json.dumps(MAP).encode(), method="POST")
        request.add_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", "k9")
        try:
            with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
                self.fail("expected the request to be rejected")
        except HTTPError as error:
            try:
                self.assertEqual(400, error.code)
            finally:
                error.close()

    def test_unsolvable_mission_returns_conflicts_over_http(self):
        self.call("POST", "/maps", {"id": "lane", "width": 4, "height": 1, "grid": ["...."]}, "k1")
        self.call(
            "POST",
            "/missions",
            {
                "id": "swap",
                "map_id": "lane",
                "agents": [
                    {"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [3, 0]},
                    {"id": "b", "start": [3, 0], "goal": [0, 0]},
                ],
            },
            "k2",
        )
        status, plan = self.call("POST", "/missions/swap/plan", {}, "k3")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertEqual("unsolvable", plan["status"])
        self.assertTrue(plan["conflicts"])
        status, error = self.call("GET", "/missions/swap/schedule")
        self.assertEqual(409, status)
        self.assertEqual("conflict", error["error"]["code"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Throwaway verification harness for the swarmgrid seed (not part of the repo).

Phase 1 checks every documented invariant on hundreds of randomly generated maps.
Phase 2 compares `unsolvable` verdicts against an exhaustive joint-path search on
small maps, to catch a planner that gives up while a valid plan exists.
"""

import itertools
import random

from swarmgrid.model import Map, Mission
from swarmgrid.solver import detect_conflicts, plan_mission, position_at

def assert_solved(map_rec, mission, result):
    order = mission.order(list(result.order))
    paths = list(result.paths)
    assert len(paths) == len(order)
    for agent, path in zip(order, paths):
        assert path[0] == agent.start, (agent.id, path)
        assert path[-1] == agent.goal, (agent.id, path)
        for index, cell in enumerate(path):
            assert map_rec.walkable(cell), (agent.id, cell)
            if index:
                previous = path[index - 1]
                assert abs(previous[0] - cell[0]) + abs(previous[1] - cell[1]) <= 1
    conflicts = detect_conflicts(order, paths)
    assert not conflicts, conflicts
    assert result.solution_makespan == max(len(path) - 1 for path in paths)
    goals = {path[-1] for path in paths}
    assert len(goals) == len(paths), "two agents settle on one cell"


def physically_sound(paths):
    """Replay a joint plan with the same rules the service documents.

    Two agents may not share a cell; they may not swap cells along an edge; and a
    waiting agent may not be crossed through by an agent moving into its cell.
    """
    horizon = max(len(path) for path in paths)
    for timestep in range(horizon + 1):
        here = [position_at(path, timestep) for path in paths]
        live = [cell for cell in here if cell is not None]
        if len(set(live)) != len(live):
            return False
        nxt = [position_at(path, timestep + 1) for path in paths]
        for left in range(len(paths)):
            for right in range(left + 1, len(paths)):
                if here[left] is None or here[right] is None:
                    continue
                if nxt[left] is None or nxt[right] is None:
                    continue
                if nxt[left] == here[right] and nxt[right] == here[left]:
                    return False
                if here[left] == nxt[left] and nxt[right] == here[left]:
                    return False
                if here[right] == nxt[right] and nxt[left] == here[right]:
                    return False
    return True


def brute(map_rec, mission, horizon=8):
    """Exhaustive joint search; returns a conflict-free plan or None."""
    agents = sorted(mission.agents, key=lambda agent: agent.id)
    all_paths = []
    for agent in agents:
        single = []
        stack = [(agent.start, (agent.start,))]
        while stack:
            cell, path = stack.pop()
            if len(path) - 1 > horizon:
                continue
            if cell == agent.goal:
                single.append(path)
                continue
            for neighbor in map_rec.neighbors(cell):
                stack.append((neighbor, path + (neighbor,)))
            stack.append((cell, path + (cell,)))
        all_paths.append(single)
    for combo in itertools.product(*all_paths):
        if not detect_conflicts(tuple(agents), list(combo)) and physically_sound(list(combo)):
            return list(combo)
    return None


def random_instance(rng, max_agents=3, obstacle_chance=0.2, max_side=6):
    width = rng.randint(2, max_side)
    height = rng.randint(2, max_side)
    rows = [
        "".join("#" if rng.random() < obstacle_chance else "." for _ in range(width))
        for _ in range(height)
    ]
    free = [(x, y) for y in range(height) for x in range(width) if rows[y][x] == "."]
    if len(free) < 3:
        return None
    map_rec = Map.parse({"id": "m", "width": width, "height": height, "grid": rows})
    count = rng.randint(1, min(max_agents, len(free) - 1))
    starts = rng.sample(free, count)
    goals = []
    for start in starts:
        canvas = [cell for cell in free if cell != start and cell not in goals]
        if not canvas:
            return None
        goals.append(rng.choice(canvas))
    agents = [
        {"id": f"a{index}", "start": list(start), "goal": list(goal)}
        for index, (start, goal) in enumerate(zip(starts, goals))
    ]
    mission = Mission.parse({"id": "x", "map_id": "m", "agents": agents}, map_rec)
    return map_rec, mission


def main():
    rng = random.Random(20260101)
    solved = 0
    unsolvable = 0
    methods = {"priority": 0, "constraint_tree": 0}
    trials = 0
    while trials < 800:
        instance = random_instance(rng)
        if instance is None:
            continue
        trials += 1
        map_rec, mission = instance
        result = plan_mission(map_rec, mission)
        if result.status == "solved":
            assert_solved(map_rec, mission, result)
            methods[result.method] += 1
            solved += 1
        else:
            assert not result.paths
            assert result.conflicts
            unsolvable += 1
    print(
        f"random invariants ok: trials={trials} solved={solved} unsolvable={unsolvable} "
        f"methods={methods}"
    )

    rng = random.Random(4242)
    checked = 0
    false_negatives = 0
    witnesses = 0
    trials = 0
    while trials < 600 and checked < 80:
        instance = random_instance(rng, max_agents=2, obstacle_chance=0.3, max_side=4)
        if instance is None:
            continue
        trials += 1
        map_rec, mission = instance
        result = plan_mission(map_rec, mission)
        if result.status == "solved":
            assert_solved(map_rec, mission, result)
            continue
        checked += 1
        witness = brute(map_rec, mission)
        if witness is None:
            continue
        witnesses += 1
        # The witness stays inside a short horizon; ask the planner for a wider
        # budget before calling this a genuine incompleteness bug.
        wider = plan_mission(map_rec, mission, order_budget=5040, tree_budget=4096)
        if wider.status != "solved":
            false_negatives += 1
            print("FALSE NEGATIVE", map_rec.rows, [a.as_dict() for a in mission.agents], witness)
    print(
        f"brute-force compared: {checked} solvable-witness={witnesses} "
        f"false negatives: {false_negatives}"
    )

    instance = random_instance(random.Random(7), max_agents=3)
    map_rec, mission = instance
    first = plan_mission(map_rec, mission)
    second = plan_mission(map_rec, mission)
    assert first == second, "planner is not deterministic"
    print("determinism ok:", first.status, first.method, first.solution_makespan)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Smoke test for the SwarmGrid service: start it, hit every route, then kill it.
set -u
cd "$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

rm -f /tmp/sg.db /tmp/sg.db-wal /tmp/sg.db-shm /tmp/sg.log
PYTHONPATH=src nohup python3 -m swarmgrid.server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18080 --database /tmp/sg.db >/tmp/sg.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 2

BASE=http://127.0.0.1:18080
JSON='Content-Type: application/json'

echo "--- server stdout ---"
cat /tmp/sg.log
echo "--- GET /health ---"
curl -s "$BASE/health"; echo
echo "--- POST /maps ---"
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/maps" -H "$JSON" -H 'Idempotency-Key: warehouse-map-1' \
  -d '{"id":"warehouse","width":5,"height":3,"grid":[".....","..##.","....."]}'; echo
echo "--- POST /maps (replayed key) ---"
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/maps" -H "$JSON" -H 'Idempotency-Key: warehouse-map-1' \
  -d '{"id":"warehouse","width":5,"height":3,"grid":[".....","..##.","....."]}'; echo
echo "--- POST /missions ---"
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/missions" -H "$JSON" -H 'Idempotency-Key: shift-1-request' \
  -d '{"id":"shift-1","map_id":"warehouse","agents":[{"id":"agv-1","start":[0,0],"goal":[4,0]},{"id":"agv-2","start":[4,0],"goal":[0,0]}]}'; echo
echo "--- POST /missions/shift-1/plan ---"
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/missions/shift-1/plan" -H "$JSON" -H 'Idempotency-Key: shift-1-plan' -d '{}'; echo
echo "--- GET /missions/shift-1 ---"
curl -s "$BASE/missions/shift-1"; echo
echo "--- GET /missions/shift-1/schedule ---"
curl -s "$BASE/missions/shift-1/schedule"; echo
echo "--- unsolvable: POST /missions/swap/plan ---"
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/maps" -H "$JSON" -H 'Idempotency-Key: lane-map' \
  -d '{"id":"lane","width":4,"height":1,"grid":["...."]}' >/dev/null
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/missions" -H "$JSON" -H 'Idempotency-Key: swap-request' \
  -d '{"id":"swap","map_id":"lane","agents":[{"id":"a","start":[0,0],"goal":[3,0]},{"id":"b","start":[3,0],"goal":[0,0]}]}' >/dev/null
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/missions/swap/plan" -H "$JSON" -H 'Idempotency-Key: swap-plan' -d '{}'; echo
echo "--- unsolvable: GET /missions/swap/schedule ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code} ' "$BASE/missions/swap/schedule"
curl -s "$BASE/missions/swap/schedule"; echo
echo "--- error: unknown field ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code} ' -X POST "$BASE/maps" -H "$JSON" -H 'Idempotency-Key: bad' \
  -d '{"id":"x","width":1,"height":1,"grid":["."],"nope":1}'
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/maps" -H "$JSON" -H 'Idempotency-Key: bad2' \
  -d '{"id":"x","width":1,"height":1,"grid":["."],"nope":1}'; echo
echo "--- error: missing mission ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code} ' "$BASE/missions/ghost"
curl -s "$BASE/missions/ghost"; echo
echo "--- error: route not found ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code} ' "$BASE/nowhere"; echo

kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
if kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then echo "server still alive, forcing"; kill -9 "$SERVER_PID"; fi
echo "--- process check ---"
pgrep -af 'swarmgrid.server' || echo 'no swarmgrid process running'

) -> tuple[Path | None, Conflict | None]:
    """Plan `agent` in space and time.

    The returned path is time indexed: `path[t]` is the cell the agent occupies
    at timestep `t`, so it stays contiguous and ends on the goal. A plan may
    include waits, and once the agent has finished it reads as `None` from
    :func:`position_at`, so a finished agent blocks nothing.

    agent go first" without forbidding the start cell outright.

def _constraint_tree(
    map_record,
    agents: tuple[Agent, ...],
    distance_from_goal: dict[Point, list[int | None]],
    tree_budget: int,
    order_budget: int = DEFAULT_ORDER_BUDGET,
) -> tuple[list[Path], list[Conflict]] | None:
    """Best-first search over sets of per-agent space-time constraints.

    Returns `(paths, [])` for a conflict-free joint plan. When no plan is found it
    returns `(infeasible_paths, [conflict])` explaining why: the failure blocking
    the best node when the tree ran out of budget, or an empty conflict list when
    every node it reached was infeasible and nothing was left to branch on.
    """
    root: ConstraintSet = {}
    paths, failure = _plan_all(map_record, agents, distance_from_goal, root, order_budget)
    if failure is None:
        return paths, []
    counter = 0
    heap: list[tuple[int, int, tuple]] = [
        (
            _paths_cost(paths) if len(paths) == len(agents) else INFEASIBLE_COST,
            counter,
            (root, paths, failure),
        )
    ]
    expanded = 0

    while heap:
        _, _, (constraints, paths, failure) = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if failure is None:
            return paths, []
        if expanded >= tree_budget:
            return paths, [failure]
        expanded += 1
        for child in _branch(constraints, failure):
            child_paths, child_failure = _plan_all(
                map_record, agents, distance_from_goal, child, order_budget
            )
            counter += 1
            heapq.heappush(
                heap,
                (
                    _paths_cost(child_paths) if child_failure is None else INFEASIBLE_COST,
                    counter,
                    (child, child_paths, child_failure),
                ),
            )
    return paths, [failure]

def _plan_all(
    map_record,
    agents: tuple[Agent, ...],
    distance_from_goal: dict[Point, list[int | None]],
    constraints: ConstraintSet,
    order_budget: int = DEFAULT_ORDER_BUDGET,
) -> tuple[list[Path], Conflict | None]:
    """Plan all agents at one node of the constraint tree.

    Because a node's leaf planner plans one agent at a time, which agent yields is
    a real choice: on a bottleneck one order finds a plan and the reverse order
    traps the lower-priority agent. Every node therefore tries the deterministic
    priority orders and keeps a conflict-free plan if one appears. When none does,
    the node reports its blocking conflict so the tree can branch on it.
    """
    fallback: Conflict | None = None

import unittest

from swarmgrid.model import Map, Mission
from swarmgrid.solver import (
    detect_conflicts,
    distance_map,
    makespan,
    position_at,
    space_time_astar,
)

OPEN_2X2 = {"id": "square", "width": 2, "height": 2, "grid": ["..", ".."]}


def build(map_payload, agents, mission_id="m"):
    map_record = Map.parse(map_payload)
    mission = Mission.parse({"id": mission_id, "map_id": map_payload["id"], "agents": agents}, map_record)
    return map_record, mission


class SingleAgentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_shortest_path_avoids_obstacles(self):
        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "w", "width": 5, "height": 2, "grid": ["..#..", "....."]},
            [{"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [4, 0]}],
        )
        agent = mission.agents[0]
        path, conflict = space_time_astar(map_record, agent, [], distance_map(map_record, agent.goal))
        self.assertIsNone(conflict)
        self.assertEqual((0, 0), path[0])
        self.assertEqual((4, 0), path[-1])
        self.assertEqual(6, makespan([path]))
        self.assertNotIn((2, 0), path)

    def test_waiting_is_used_when_a_cell_is_blocked_for_one_tick(self):
        map_record, mission = build(
            OPEN_2X2,
            [{"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [1, 0]}],
        )
        agent = mission.agents[0]
        blocked = frozenset({((1, 0), 1)})
        path, conflict = space_time_astar(
            map_record, agent, [], distance_map(map_record, agent.goal), blocked
        )
        self.assertIsNone(conflict)
        self.assertEqual(((0, 0), (0, 0), (1, 0)), path)

    def test_unreachable_goal_reports_a_conflict(self):
        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "w", "width": 5, "height": 3, "grid": [".#...", "##...", "....."]},
            [{"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [0, 2]}],
        )
        agent = mission.agents[0]
        path, conflict = space_time_astar(map_record, agent, [], distance_map(map_record, agent.goal))
        self.assertIsNone(path)
        self.assertEqual("unreachable_goal", conflict.type)


class OccupancyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_finished_agent_no_longer_occupies_its_goal(self):
        path = ((0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 0))
        self.assertEqual((1, 0), position_at(path, 1))
        self.assertIsNone(position_at(path, 3))

    def test_following_is_legal(self):
        lead = ((0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0))
        trail = ((1, 0), (1, 0), (1, 0), (1, 0))
        agents = (
            _agent("lead", (0, 0), (2, 0)),
            _agent("trail", (1, 0), (1, 0)),
        )
        # trail occupies (1, 0) from t=0; lead passes through it at t=1.
        # Sharing a cell is never allowed, so this plan must be reported.
        conflicts = detect_conflicts(agents, [lead, trail])
        self.assertTrue(any(conflict.type == "vertex" for conflict in conflicts))

        # When trail leaves on the same tick lead arrives, the two never share
        # the cell and the plan is clean.
        moving = ((1, 0), (1, 1), (1, 2), (2, 2))
        self.assertEqual([], detect_conflicts(agents, [lead, moving]))

    def test_a_swap_is_reported(self):
        first = ((0, 0), (1, 0))
        second = ((1, 0), (0, 0))
        agents = (_agent("a", (0, 0), (1, 0)), _agent("b", (1, 0), (0, 0)))
        conflicts = detect_conflicts(agents, [first, second])
        self.assertEqual(["edge"], [conflict.type for conflict in conflicts])
        self.assertEqual(0, conflicts[0].timestep)

    def test_sharing_a_cell_is_reported(self):
        first = ((0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 0))
        second = ((1, 0), (1, 0), (0, 0))
        agents = (_agent("a", (0, 0), (1, 0)), _agent("b", (1, 0), (0, 0)))
        conflicts = detect_conflicts(agents, [first, second])
        self.assertTrue(any(conflict.type == "vertex" for conflict in conflicts))

    def test_two_agents_settling_on_one_cell_is_a_conflict(self):
        first = ((0, 0), (1, 0))
        second = ((1, 1), (1, 0))
        agents = (_agent("a", (0, 0), (1, 0)), _agent("b", (1, 1), (1, 0)))
        conflicts = detect_conflicts(agents, [first, second])
        self.assertTrue(any(conflict.type == "vertex" for conflict in conflicts))

    def test_opposite_agents_in_a_corridor_are_routed_around_each_other(self):
        from swarmgrid.solver import plan_mission

        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "c", "width": 5, "height": 3, "grid": [".....", "..##.", "....."]},
            [

                {"id": "b", "start": [4, 0], "goal": [0, 0]},

        self.assertEqual("solved", result.status)

        self.assertEqual([], conflicts)
        self.assertEqual([], detect_conflicts(agents, paths))
        self.assertEqual(3, makespan(paths))

        self.assertEqual("priority", priority.method)
        self.assertEqual(tuple(paths), priority.paths)

    def test_the_constraint_tree_stops_at_its_node_budget(self):
        from swarmgrid.solver import _constraint_tree

        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "lane", "width": 4, "height": 1, "grid": ["...."]},
            [
                {"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [3, 0]},
                {"id": "b", "start": [3, 0], "goal": [0, 0]},
            ],

        agents = tuple(sorted(mission.agents, key=lambda agent: agent.id))
        distances = {agent.goal: distance_map(map_record, agent.goal) for agent in agents}
        paths, conflicts = _constraint_tree(map_record, agents, distances, 0)
        self.assertTrue(conflicts)
        self.assertEqual([], list(paths))

    def test_swapping_agents_in_a_single_lane_stay_unsolvable(self):
        from swarmgrid.solver import plan_mission

        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "lane", "width": 4, "height": 1, "grid": ["...."]},
            [
                {"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [3, 0]},
                {"id": "b", "start": [3, 0], "goal": [0, 0]},
            ],
        )
        result = plan_mission(map_record, mission, tree_budget=256)
        self.assertEqual("unsolvable", result.status)
        self.assertTrue(result.conflicts)
        self.assertEqual([], list(result.paths))

    def test_a_free_map_needs_no_replanning(self):
        from swarmgrid.solver import plan_mission

        map_record, mission = build(
            {"id": "open", "width": 6, "height": 4, "grid": ["......"] * 4},
            [
                {"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [5, 0]},
                {"id": "b", "start": [5, 3], "goal": [0, 3]},
            ],
        )
        result = plan_mission(map_record, mission)
        self.assertEqual("solved", result.status)
        self.assertEqual("priority", result.method)
        self.assertEqual(5, result.solution_makespan)


def _agent(agent_id, start, goal):
    from swarmgrid.model import Agent

    return Agent(agent_id, start, goal)

def closure(cells, start, end):

def build(map_payload, agents, mission_id="m"):

            [{"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [4, 0]}],
        )
        agent = mission.agents[0]
        path, conflict = space_time_astar(map_record, agent, [], distance_map(map_record, agent.goal))

    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()

        self.service.create_map(corridor_map(), "map-1")

            },
            "mission-m1",
        )

    def tearDown(self):
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def plan(self, closures, key):
        return self.service.plan("m1", {"closures": closures}, key)

    def test_cells_must_be_a_non_empty_array_of_unique_in_bounds_points(self):
        cases = [
            ([{"start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], "missing required fields"),
            ([{"cells": [], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], "non-empty array"),
            ([{"cells": [[2, 0], [2, 0]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], "must not repeat"),
            ([{"cells": [[9, 0]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], "between 0 and 4"),
            ([{"cells": [[2, 1]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], "obstacle cell"),
            ([{"cells": [2, 0], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], r"\[x, y\] pair"),
        ]
        for index, (closures, pattern) in enumerate(cases):
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, pattern):
                    self.plan(closures, f"k{index}")

    def test_ticks_are_bounded_and_ordered(self):
        cases = [
            ([[{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": -1, "end_tick": 0}]], "between 0 and"),

            ([[{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": 3, "end_tick": 2}]], "less than or equal"),

            ([[{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": "0"}]], "must be an integer"),
        ]
        for index, (closures, pattern) in enumerate(cases):
            with self.subTest(index=index):

    def test_array_and_entry_limits_are_enforced(self):

class ClosureValidationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.service = SwarmGrid(str(Path(self.directory.name) / "test.db"))
        self.service.create_map(corridor_map(), "map-1")
        self.service.create_mission(
            {
                "id": "m1",
                "map_id": "corridor",
                "agents": [{"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [4, 0]}],
            },
            "mission-m1",
        )

    def tearDown(self):
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def plan(self, closures, key):
        return self.service.plan("m1", {"closures": closures}, key)

    def test_cells_must_be_a_non_empty_array_of_unique_in_bounds_points(self):
        cases = [
            ([{"start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], "missing required fields"),
            ([{"cells": [], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], "non-empty array"),
            ([{"cells": [[2, 0], [2, 0]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], "must not repeat"),
            ([{"cells": [[9, 0]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], "between 0 and 4"),
            ([{"cells": [[2, 1]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], "obstacle cell"),
            ([{"cells": [2, 0], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}], r"\[x, y\] pair"),
        ]
        for index, (closures, pattern) in enumerate(cases):
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, pattern):
                    self.plan(closures, f"k{index}")

    def test_ticks_are_bounded_and_ordered(self):
        cases = [
            ([[{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": -1, "end_tick": 0}]], "between 0 and"),
            ([[{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 100001}]], "between 0 and"),
            ([[{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": 3, "end_tick": 2}]], "less than or equal"),
            ([[{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": True, "end_tick": 0}]], "must be an integer"),
            ([[{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": "0"}]], "must be an integer"),
        ]
        for index, (closures, pattern) in enumerate(cases):
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, pattern):
                    self.plan(closures[0], f"k{index}")

    def test_array_and_entry_limits_are_enforced(self):
        too_many_cells = [{"cells": [[0, 0]] * 65, "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0}]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "64 cells"):
            self.plan(too_many_cells, "k-cells")
        too_many_entries = [
            {"cells": [[0, 0]], "start_tick": index, "end_tick": index} for index in range(65)
        ]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "64 entries"):
            self.plan(too_many_entries, "k-entries")

    def test_shape_and_unknown_fields_are_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "closures must be an array"):
            self.service.plan("m1", {"closures": {"cells": []}}, "k-shape")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "closures\\[0\\] must be an object"):
            self.plan(["nope"], "k-item")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValidationError, "unknown fields"):
            self.plan([{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 0, "note": "x"}], "k-unknown")

    def test_closures_combine_with_the_other_plan_options(self):
        plan = self.service.plan(
            "m1",
            {"priority": ["a"], "order_budget": 1, "tree_budget": 0, "closures": []},
            "k-combo",
        )
        self.assertEqual("solved", plan["status"])
        self.assertEqual(["a"], plan["priority_order"])

        )

        self.create("m1", [{"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [4, 0]}])

            "m1", {"closures": [{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": 2, "end_tick": 2}]}, "p1"
        )
        self.assertEqual("solved", plan["status"])
        self.assertEqual(5, plan["makespan"])
        path = plan["agents"][0]["path"]
        for timestep, cell in enumerate(path):
            self.assertFalse(timestep == 2 and cell == [2, 0])

    def test_blocked_mission_reports_a_closure_conflict(self):
        self.create("m1", [{"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [4, 0]}])

            "m1", {"closures": [{"cells": [[2, 0]], "start_tick": 0, "end_tick": 40}]}, "p1"
        )
        self.assertEqual("unsolvable", plan["status"])
        self.assertIsNone(plan["makespan"])
        self.assertNotIn("agents", plan)
        (conflict,) = plan["conflicts"]
        self.assertEqual("closure", conflict["type"])
        self.assertEqual(2, conflict["timestep"])
        self.assertEqual("a", conflict["agent"])
        self.assertEqual([2, 0], conflict["position"])
        self.assertIsNone(conflict["other"])
        self.assertIsNone(conflict["other_position"])

The body is optional; an empty object is enough. The body accepts four optional
fields:

- `priority` — an explicit priority order: every agent id of the mission,
  exactly once. When present the planner uses that order only.
- `order_budget` — how many priority orders the planner may try, an integer
  between 1 and 5040 (default 24, capped by the factorial of the agent count).
- `tree_budget` — how many nodes the conflict-tree stage may expand, an integer
  between 0 and 4096 (default 64). Raise it to search harder before giving up.
- `closures` — task-level temporary road blocks, an array of up to 64 entries.
  Each entry contains exactly `cells`, `start_tick`, and `end_tick`:
  - `cells` is a non-empty array of up to 64 unique `[x, y]` points, each inside
    the map and not a static obstacle;
  - `start_tick` and `end_tick` are integers with
    `0 <= start_tick <= end_tick <= 100000`.

  The tick interval is inclusive on both ends. During every timestep
  `start_tick..end_tick` none of the listed cells may be entered, waited on, or
  held by any agent; outside the interval the cells are ordinary ground. The
  closures feed both the space-time search and conflict resolution, so a plan is
  delayed or detoured around a closed cell rather than touching it. Omitting
  `closures` (or sending `[]`) means no temporary closure, and the request is
  then identical to the body-less case.

`unsolvable` means no collision-free joint plan was found inside the budgets, so
no path data is returned. `conflicts` is sorted and de-duplicated, and each
entry has these fields:

- `type` is `vertex`, `edge`, `unreachable_goal`, or `closure`;
- `timestep` is the timestep at which the collision occurs, or the tick that
  blocks the agent; `0` for an `unreachable_goal`;
- `agent` is the agent that could not be routed;
- `other` is the other agent involved, or `null`;
- `position` and `other_position` are the cells involved, or `null`;
- `message` is a human readable sentence.

A `closure` entry names a temporary road block that stops an agent: `timestep`
is the first forbidden tick the search needs, `position` is the closed cell,
`other` and `other_position` are `null`, and the message states that the closure
blocks that agent. When an agent's start is covered by a closure whose
`start_tick` is `0`, the agent cannot even occupy its first cell, so the
mission is reported `unsolvable` without trying orders: one diagnostic per
blocked agent is returned, sorted by `agent_id`, each with `timestep` `0` and
`position` equal to that agent's start.

A malformed `closures` value (bad shape, out-of-range ticks, an out-of-bounds or
obstacle cell, too many entries or cells, and so on) is a `validation_error`.

import itertools
from swarmgrid.model import Map, Mission, Closure
from swarmgrid.solver import plan_mission, position_at, ClosureTable

rows=['#.','..','..']; w,h=2,3
m=Map.parse({"id":"m","width":w,"height":h,"grid":rows})
agents=[{"id":"a0","start":[1,1],"goal":[0,2]},{"id":"a1","start":[1,2],"goal":[1,0]}]
mis=Mission.parse({"id":"x","map_id":"m","agents":agents},m)
clos=[Closure(((1,2),(0,2),(0,1)),1,7)]
table=ClosureTable(clos)

def brute(map_rec, agents, table, horizon=12):
    all_paths=[]
    for agent in agents:
        single=[]; stack=[(agent.start,(agent.start,))]
        while stack:
            cell,path=stack.pop(); t=len(path)-1
            if table.blocks(cell,t): continue
            if t>horizon: continue
            if cell==agent.goal: single.append(path); continue
            for nb in map_rec.neighbors(cell):
                if not table.blocks(nb,t+1): stack.append((nb,path+(nb,)))
            if not table.blocks(cell,t+1): stack.append((cell,path+(cell,)))
        all_paths.append(single)
    def ok(combo):
        if len({p[-1] for p in combo})!=len(combo): return False
        H=max(len(p) for p in combo)
        for t in range(H):
            here=[position_at(p,t) for p in combo]; live=[c for c in here if c]
            if len(set(live))!=len(live): return False
            nxt=[position_at(p,t+1) for p in combo]
            for i in range(len(combo)):
                for j in range(i+1,len(combo)):

                        return False
        return True
    for combo in itertools.product(*all_paths):
        if ok(combo): return combo
    return None

wit=brute(m,tuple(sorted(mis.agents,key=lambda a:a.id)),table,12)

import json
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

from swarmgrid.server import Handler
from swarmgrid.service import SwarmGrid

MAP = {"id": "grid", "width": 5, "height": 3, "grid": [".....", "..##.", "....."]}
MISSION = {
    "id": "run-1",
    "map_id": "grid",
    "agents": [
        {"id": "a", "start": [0, 0], "goal": [4, 0]},
        {"id": "b", "start": [4, 0], "goal": [0, 0]},
    ],
}


class ServerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        Handler.service = SwarmGrid(str(Path(self.directory.name) / "http.db"))
        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}"

    def tearDown(self):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join(timeout=5)
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def call(self, method, path, payload=None, key=None):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
        request = Request(f"{self.base}{path}", data=body, method=method)
        request.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        if key:
            request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", key)
        try:
            with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
                return response.status, json.loads(response.read())
        except HTTPError as error:
            try:
                return error.code, json.loads(error.read())
            finally:
                error.close()

    def raw(self, method, path, payload=None, key=None):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
        request = Request(f"{self.base}{path}", data=body, method=method)
        request.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        if key:
            request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", key)
        with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
            return response.status, response.read()

    def test_health(self):
        self.assertEqual((200, {"status": "ok"}), self.call("GET", "/health"))

    def test_full_planning_flow_over_http(self):
        status, created = self.call("POST", "/maps", MAP, "map-1")
        self.assertEqual(201, status)
        self.assertEqual("grid", created["id"])
        status, mission = self.call("POST", "/missions", MISSION, "mission-1")
        self.assertEqual(201, status)
        self.assertEqual("created", mission["status"])
        status, plan = self.call("POST", "/missions/run-1/plan", {}, "plan-1")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertEqual("solved", plan["status"])
        self.assertEqual(8, plan["makespan"])
        status, stored = self.call("GET", "/missions/run-1")
        self.assertEqual(plan, stored["plan"])
        status, schedule = self.call("GET", "/missions/run-1/schedule")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertEqual(9, len(schedule["timeline"]))
        self.assertEqual(
            {"a": None, "b": [0, 0]}, schedule["timeline"][-1]["positions"]
        )
        self.assertEqual("priority", plan["method"])

    def test_error_envelope_and_status_codes(self):
        status, error = self.call("POST", "/maps", {**MAP, "extra": 1}, "k1")
        self.assertEqual(400, status)
        self.assertEqual("validation_error", error["error"]["code"])
        status, error = self.call("GET", "/maps/missing")
        self.assertEqual(404, status)
        self.assertEqual("not_found", error["error"]["code"])
        status, error = self.call("POST", "/missions", MISSION, "k2")
        self.assertEqual(404, status)
        status, error = self.call("GET", "/nope")
        self.assertEqual(404, status)
        self.assertEqual("not_found", error["error"]["code"])

    def test_replayed_request_is_byte_identical(self):
        first_status, first = self.raw("POST", "/maps", MAP, "map-1")
        second_status, second = self.raw("POST", "/maps", MAP, "map-1")
        self.assertEqual(201, first_status)
        self.assertEqual(201, second_status)
        self.assertEqual(first, second)

    def test_idempotency_and_content_type(self):
        self.call("POST", "/maps", MAP, "map-1")
        status, first = self.call("POST", "/missions", MISSION, "same-key")
        self.assertEqual(201, status)
        status, repeated = self.call("POST", "/missions", MISSION, "same-key")
        self.assertEqual(201, status)
        self.assertEqual(first, repeated)
        request = Request(f"{self.base}/maps", data=json.dumps(MAP).encode(), method="POST")
        request.add_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", "k9")
        try:
            with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
                self.fail("expected the request to be rejected")
        except HTTPError as error:
            try:
                self.assertEqual(400, error.code)
            finally:
                error.close()

            },
            "k2",
        )
        status, plan = self.call("POST", "/missions/swap/plan", {}, "k3")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertEqual("unsolvable", plan["status"])
        self.assertTrue(plan["conflicts"])
        status, error = self.call("GET", "/missions/swap/schedule")
        self.assertEqual(409, status)
        self.assertEqual("conflict", error["error"]["code"])

    unittest.main()
